article.title: Los Angeles faces New Orleans on 3-game home skid
article.linkText: Los Angeles faces New Orleans on 3-game home skid
article.story: New Orleans Pelicans (4-5, 11th in the Western Conference) vs. Los Angeles Clippers (1-7, 13th in the Western Conference) Inglewood, California; Sunday, 9 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: Los Angeles hosts New Orleans looking to end its three-game home slide. Los Angeles finished 42-40 overall and 25-27 in Western Conference action a season ago. The Clippers allowed opponents to score 112.6 points per game and shoot 46.9% from the field last season. New Orleans went 26-56 overall and 17-34 in Western Conference action during the 2025-26 season. The Pelicans gave up 120.0 points per game while committing 19.9 fouls last season. INJURIES: Clippers: Yanic Konan Niederhauser: out (lisfranc), Jordan Miller: out (shoulder), Brandon Ingram: out (heel), Bradley Beal: out (knee). Pelicans: Yves Missi: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
